title: Receipt ACK on a Central-homed native relay mailbox returns 404 'native mailbox association not found' after a successful read (post-restart)
outcome: After termal_read_mailbox returns a page and an issued receipt for a native relay mailbox homed on Central, termal_acknowledge_mailbox with the same mailbox id and the unchanged receipt succeeds and advances the cursor, including after a host restart. Strict ownership stays: a different member's ACK is still refused, and is told apart from a missing association.
acceptance: After a valid member reads a Central-homed native relay mailbox and receives a page receipt, losing its cached relay association does not strand the receipt: ACK using the unchanged locator and receipt recovers validated association and advances the proper cursor, or returns an actionable re-resolve refusal without changing any cursor.

Missing association is distinguished from an association owned by another member; wrong-member, invalid-receipt and mismatched-home ACK attempts remain refused and never advance a cursor or acquire another member's association.

Behavioural regressions cover read -> association loss -> unchanged receipt ACK for local Central home, plus ownership/refusal controls; required focused checks, independent review pair and exact-input full gate pass before landing. No repository Markdown/instruction-content tests are added.

completion.summary: Landed the concurred actionable409 refusal lane for local-home missing association, retaining ownership/home/receipt guards. Three behavioral regressions, independent source pair, exact-input focused and exact-tree full gate passed before push; original live cause unproven. Installation remains integration-owned and deferred.
